summary: Cutover plan to move runtime ownership from gateway-local event execution and persistence into kernel execution boundary, while preserving gateway ingress and adapter roles.

gateway_routes.recommended_kernel_delegate: kernel.execute() for POST /events; kernel event read model for GET paths
gateway_routes.notes: Event write path is the highest priority cutover.

gateway_routes.recommended_kernel_delegate: keep as gateway persistence adapter for objects; if object workflow becomes kernel-owned, delegate to kernel service via adapter
gateway_routes.notes: Repository object storage may remain gateway adapter-level unless object semantics move into kernel.

gateway_routes.recommended_kernel_delegate: context read models from kernel-owned event store; keep gateway routes as read-only facade
gateway_routes.notes: Context queries should read the canonical repository persisted by kernel.

gateway_routes.recommended_kernel_delegate: system state should aggregate from kernel authorities and event state via EventReadAuthority
gateway_routes.notes: System authority remains gateway-facing operational guard.

gateway_routes.recommended_kernel_delegate: inference orchestration should call kernel inference authority or kernel-managed adapter, not raw adapter.
gateway_routes.notes: Ollama routing logic currently uses constitutionalTimeAuthority; keep gateway ingress only.

legacy_kernel_routes.recommended: review as legacy conduit. If still needed, refactor to adapter role or retire.
retain only if audit interface is required; otherwise remove from production route graph.

finalization.handoff: gateway routes remain ingress-only; kernel boundary owns mission execution, event persistence, witness, replay, and certification.
finalization.verification: static route evidence should show gateway route -> kernel execution adapter -> runtime modules without gateway-local execution logic.
finalization.rollback: phase 2 should preserve gateway route tests and allow rollback to current gateway-local execution if kernel adapter fails.
